name: Thornback Tactical Hood — Detach Series 3
description: A standalone tactical hood from Thornback, a street-adjacent security outfitter operating out of Circuit Ward 12. Cut from laminated ballistic ripstop in matte black with subtle olive undertone, it features a built-in balaclava liner that can be rolled down into the collar. The rear panel has a split-channel seam running crown to neck — accommodating spinal rigs and dorsal chrome up to 40mm profile. Horn slots at the crown are reinforced with bonded flex-rubber grommets, cleanly finished. Attachment points at the collar connect to standard tactical plate carrier mounts.
materials: roll-down balaclava liner in brushed moisture-wicking mesh
functionality: Full head and neck coverage. Balaclava liner can be worn or stowed. Split rear seam accommodates spinal rigs and dorsal chrome. Horn grommets prevent pressure sores during extended wear. Collar mounts attach to compatible vest systems. Rain-repellent outer treatment.
what_it_says: You've thought about every angle of what could come at your head, biological or ballistic.
story_hooks: The split-channel seam design was reverse-engineered from a stolen Axiom Defense prototype — Axiom has been trying to trace the leak for two years.
A specific run of Series 3 hoods was sold to both sides of a Circuit Ward 12 territorial dispute; the hoods are identical, and the bodies are sometimes hard to tell apart afterward.
A geneware-modded individual with full rack horns wore this hood through a corponation checkpoint without being flagged — the grommets suppress heat signature from horn bases.
related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Aegis CorpSec Hardened Security BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, utilitarian hood with pronounced architectural lines. The split-channel seam creates a subtle ridge down the back, giving it an almost vertebral appearance. When worn, it frames the face with sharp angles and projects an unmistakably security-oriented aesthetic. The matte finish absorbs light, making it blend into shadow while the olive undertone catches ambient neon.
physical_description.fit: Snug and conforming around the head and neck without restriction. The hood sits close to the skull to accommodate augmentation profiles underneath. Designed for layering over chrome and internal hardware rather than direct skin contact.
physical_description.primary_material: Laminated ballistic ripstop — a synthetic composite with woven reinforcement visible as subtle grid texture
physical_description.texture: Smooth matte finish with a faint tactile ripple from the ripstop weave. The balaclava liner is softer, brushed on the interior. The flex-rubber grommets at the crown have a slightly rubbery grip. The split-channel seam is bonded and raised, creating a tactile ridge.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte black base with subdued olive-green undertone that emerges under direct light or neon glow. No visible logos or patches — pure functional minimalism.
physical_description.closures: None — designed as a pull-over hood. Attachment points are magnetic snap receptors at the collar for tactical rig integration, not closure.
distinctive_features: Split-channel rear seam running crown to neck for spinal rig and dorsal chrome accommodation (up to 40mm profile)
Reinforced horn slots at crown with bonded flex-rubber grommets
Built-in balaclava liner that rolls down into collar for modular coverage
Standard tactical plate carrier mounting points at collar
Laminated ballistic ripstop construction visible as grid texture
No branding — manufacturer confidence through design alone
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3–4 functional. Priced for working security, enforcement, and street operators. Not entry-level Tier 5, but not corpo luxury Tier 1.
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals active security work, street enforcement, or augmentation-heavy lifestyle. Worn by those with spinal rigs, chrome dorsal work, or tactical coordination. Marks the wearer as someone who operates in gray zones—not corporate, not civilian, not underground.
physical_description.condition_typical: Typically appears broken-in but maintained. Light abrasions on the crown from repeated donning; the flex-rubber grommets show minor wear polish. No tears or patches — users replace before that threshold.
